sources.title: Chatbox AI
sources.snippet: Chatbox AI is an all-in-one AI platform offering advanced tools such as AI Chat, AI Image Generation, PDF Chat, and Web Search. It provides access to multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) and image generation models from leading providers, all within a single and user-friendly interface.

sources.title: Chatterbox: Open Source Text-to-Speech | Resemble AI
sources.snippet: Chatterbox is Resemble AI's free, open-source TTS model, MIT-licensed with emotion control, real-time generation, and zero-shot voice cloning from 5 seconds of audio.
